services.name: Kayak Cart
services.desc: Our waterfront rental shop located in Kingston, Ontario is a 10 minute walk from downtown Kingston. We have everything you need to make your rental an easy and enjoyable experience. If you book ahead, we will have your equipment ready by our launching dock. We have parking right at our location, change rooms, public washrooms and a complimentary key or valuable drop. If you want to take your phone on the water, we recommend renting one of our waterproof phone cases, just ask our staff. It is a good idea to check wind conditions before heading out, visit Weather and Wind Conditions to learn more. Connect with us on Instagram, Facebook, and Tripadvisor to share your pics and stories, and let

blurb: Ahoy Rentals offers kayaking, stand up paddle boarding, canoeing, cycling and sailing rentals. They provide route suggestions and instruction in kayak, canoe, SUP, and sailing in small groups. Skippered sailing charters are available for groups up to 5 aboard a 26' sailboat with no sailing experience required.
